caseName: City of Richmond v. United States
caseNameFull: City of Richmond, Virginia v. United States

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. D. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 419 U. S. 1067.] Joint motion for additional time for oral argument granted and a total of one hour and 20 minutes allotted for that purpose.

Mr. Justice Marshall and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.*
